caption: The drawing depicts a stylized plant composition set against a light brown rectangular background, bordered by a wider off-white margin. At the center of the image is a symmetrical plant with a red stem and branches, featuring three prominent green leaves or petals at the top, outlined in red. On either side of the central motif, there are two large pod-like shapes, each consisting of green, brown, and red sections outlined in red. Below these, on both the left and right, are large green leaves outlined in red, forming a mirrored arrangement. The lower portion of the drawing contains a green triangular base, with three black tulip-shaped flowers with stems emerging from it, each with an additional small black leaf shape. The entire design is rendered in a flat, decorative style using bold, solid colors of green, red, brown, black, and ochre against the rectangular light brown field.
title: Study for Proposed Portfolio "Decorated Chests of Rural Pennsylvania"
